integrity: Two independent complete enumerators and two border-computation methods on every canonical set-partition representative. Exact finite proof using checked executable source, not an infinite computation claim.
scientific_limitations: The complete maximal-rank and rank-distribution classification is confined to word lengths 1 through 11; existence of rank-five arrays persists to arbitrary greater length, but no maximum-rank claim is made beyond 11. An equivalent unindexed census cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp initial alphabet-rank thresholds for Abelian border arrays
